name: Izayoi Sounosuke
source: Izayoi Sounosuke is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 9 Director. His responsibility as the director is preparation, development, and management of armaments and weapons. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
